text:
sam: quick flag 1 — were seeing ~3% structured funcall failures on zephyr-int4 canary where JSON parses until the end then parser errors on trailing garbage.

sam: raw example:```
{"tool":"kb_search","args":["inference best practices"]}
```

nina: any obvious correlates? batch size / kv cache / seq len?

sam: yes: most failures when batch_size >= 12 && kv_cache=true. single-request flows almost clean.

raj: sounds like a decode boundary leak after quantized decode. two pragmatic options: sanitizer that trims non-utf8 tails + NDJSON-last-object fallback, or a sentinel/anchor suffix validated before parsing.

oscar: propose an A/B/C canary on 5% traffic: A) baseline B) sanitizer+1 retry C) per-request sentinel `<<END:crc32:BASE64(salt)>>` (salted per request) and validate. collect sentinel_collision_count.

nina: measurement plan: 2k structured calls per arm. metrics: schema_compliance, parse_fallback_used, p95/p99 latency, sanitizer_trim_pct, sentinel_collision_count, parse_error_class (invalid_utf8|trailing_bytes|incomplete).

sam: I pushed a small harness that reproduces the trailing bytes locally when continuous-batch + kvcache reuse; linking INF-9900.

ioscar: implementation note: keep both behaviors behind runtime flags `postproc.sanitize_trail` and `postproc.sentinel_suffix`. send metric tags: model=zephyr-int4, quant=int4, batch_size, kvcache_hit, arm.

raj: long-term lane: instrument raw token bytes post-decode on failures (dump to secure bucket, PII-safe) and trace kernel path. file INF-9901. want root cause, postproc is a bandaid.

canary-bot: canary update 0: zephyr-int4 at 5% traffic. rolling schema_fail(30m): 3.2%.

nina: I'll run the 2k per-arm test tonight and post the mini-notebook results here tomorrow AM. if sanitizer wins but harms p95, we can gate it only on retry.

oscar: also add `parse_fallback_detail` dimension to logs (which fallback matched). helps triage.

sam: thanks 1 — tagging raj/oscar on both tickets. will report back with counts.
